objective: To list the customer order lines cancelled in GTOPAS (UPD_STATUS '2', set by XD08) whose qty is already in a submitted ASN.

To move the cancelled qty to order lines of the same part that GTOPAS has received (UPD_STATUS '6', PO_MAPPED_FLAG 'N', not in an ASN), so that the cases of the ASN keep a valid customer order (decided 23-Oct; replaces the former XD11 cancel batch and the CONFLICT handling outside the system).
D/S team only: sub menu of ASN (next to ASN Creation).

operation.text: 5.2 Detail Mode and Change Order Number

items: Candidates: lines of the same part with UPD_STATUS '6', PO_MAPPED_FLAG 'N' and no row in TB_R_INSTRUCTION, oldest Customer Order Date first. Another destination is allowed. The oldest lines whose qty adds up to the cancelled qty are pre-ticked; the D/S team can change the ticks.
[Change Order Number] is enabled only when the ticked qty equals the cancelled qty (message no. 2 as hint otherwise). Confirmation message no. 3.

[Yes], in one transaction: the cancelled qty is moved case by case (from the last case) to the ticked lines in their order; a TB_R_INSTRUCTION row is updated when it moves completely and split (new row) when only part of it moves. The ASN, its cases, CASE_NO and PO do not change. Replacement lines: PO_MAPPED_FLAG 'Y'. Cancelled line: not changed. One history record per moved piece. The row leaves the list.
Re-check in the same transaction: when a candidate was taken in the meantime (PO_MAPPED_FLAG 'Y' or row in TB_R_INSTRUCTION), nothing is saved and message no. 4 is shown; the detail is refreshed.

18-Oct: cases 1-4 of order date 17-Oct are sent in ASN0003 (case 3 = CO-14104, TH, 6 pcs, a middle row). 19-Oct: CO-14104 is cancelled (waiting for a candidate). 21-Oct: CO-14111 (TH, 6 pcs, order date 19-Oct) is received in GTOPAS (UPD_STATUS 6, PO_MAPPED_FLAG N, no ASN). The D/S team moves the 6 pcs of case C-0003-03 to CO-14111.
Other example (ERD SIM-6, partial cancel): CO-B 8 pcs in ASN00020 (case 1: 4, case 2: 4), 6 pcs cancelled: case 2 4 pcs + 2 of the 4 pcs of case 1 (row split) move to CO-E (4) and CO-F (2).

tables.name: TB_R_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Real mapping made by [Create ASN]: one row per supplier case x customer order line x PO of the chosen blocks (case and line sequence of XD09). Rows are deleted by [Back] / [Cancel] on the Case List; [Submit ASN] (5.7) fills ASN_NO and CASE_NO. Columns proposed. Rows without ASN_NO are a draft: every run of XD08 releases all drafts (decided 23-Oct); a cancelled line in a submitted ASN is moved to other lines in Change Order Number (XD11).
columns: Supplier code (one ASN = one Supplier Code + Plant)

Order line x PO within the case

Qty of the line mapped to the PO in this case

Draft of one [Create ASN] (all rows of the creation); NULL after [Submit ASN] is not needed (ASN_NO filled). Every run of XD08 deletes the rows with ASN_NO NULL
ASN number; NULL until the ASN is submitted (5.7)
Case number; NULL until submitted (auto generated with the existing last sequence)
User who last changed the record
